#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int W, M;
    cin >> W >> M;

    vector<int> B(101, 0);
    int val = M;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        B[i] = val % W;
        val /= W;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        if (B[i] > 1) {
            B[i] -= W;
            B[i + 1]++;
        }
    }

    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; ++i) {
        if (B[i] < -1 || B[i] > 1) {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;

    return 0;
}
